snippet.title: BULLRING // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2613310/BULLRING/

Bullring, ring of the warriors. Fight in close combat or from a distance with your magic to get far from the fatal attacks of enemy! Use your skills and be in contact with your allies for additional power! Enjoy while slashing them to the pieces!

Developed by
Great Indie Games

*Notice: BULLRING is no longer available on the Steam store
